medical.name: F.A.S.T
medical.effect: Applying a First Aid Spray Treatment (F.A.S.T) restore 5 HEALTH and MORALE instantly; no effect on TRAUMA.

medical.name: Stim Pak
medical.effect: Applying a Stim pack restores 5 HEALTH and MORALE to the target and clears any LIGHT TRAUMA. No effect SEVERE TRAUMA.

medical.name: Trauma pack
medical.effect: Applying a Trauma pack restores 10 HEALTH and MORALE, removes all LIGHT TRAUMA and lets the target ignore the effect of SEVERE TRAUMA for a day.

medical.name: Bio gel
medical.effect: Target will now recovers 1 HEALTH and MORALE during each maintenance phases

medical.name: Zombi
medical.effect: Target takes half damage from all sources (round up) and ignores the negative effect of all TRAUMA (does not prevent TRAUMA).

medical.name: Hype-X
medical.effect: Target gains 1 surge point every maintenance phase but now has a LARGE penalty to all PHYSICAL checks. (Surge is lost if not used in the same round).

medical.name: Though-Up
medical.effect: Doubles your trauma threshold for both HEALTH and MORALE

medical.name: Atrophol
medical.effect: Ignore the effects of toxic environments and critical BIO ailments.

medical.name: Sinitol
medical.effect: Stops your body from radiating heat, slows down heartbeat and makes user quasi invisible to electronic surveillance. LARGE bonus to STEALTH vs Electronics, SMALL bonus vs everything else.

medical.name: Stazz
medical.effect: Prevent someone in a dying state from dying. Target is auto stabilized. Additional wounds can still kill the target.

medical.name: Blue Skie
medical.effect: Gain a LARGE bonus to ENDURANCE and WILLPOWER but a LARGE penalty to MENTAL and ACUITY

medical.name: Spa Day
medical.effect: Small tablets that induce a sense of bliss on the user. All WILLPOWER checks are lucky, all WITS checks are now UNLUCKY

medical.name: Asylum
medical.effect: Taking asylum shield's the user's brain from external distractions. You gain a LARGE bonus to WILLPOWER defense but you no longer track your own HEALTH (GM will track damage to HEALTH for player during effect).

medical.name: EnergeX
medical.effect: Increase MOVEMENT by 1 and running speed is now x3 instead of x2. Has opposite effect after the SCENE.

medical.name: Juice-R
medical.effect: Increases PHYSICAL attribute by 3 for a SCENE

medical.name: Mentats
medical.effect: Increases MENTAL attribute by 3 for a SCENE

medical.name: GlameX
medical.effect: Increases SOCIAL attribute by 3 for a SCENE

medical.name: Hyperfocus
medical.effect: Increases ACUITY attribute by 3 for a SCENE

medical.name: No Painz
medical.effect: Increases ENDURANCE defense by 3 for a SCENE

medical.name: Go Fast
medical.effect: Increases SPEED defense by 3 for a SCENE

medical.name: WitreX
medical.effect: Increases WITS defense by 3 for a SCENE

medical.name: IronMind
medical.effect: Increases WILLPOWER defense by 3 for a SCENE

medical.name: Chrono
medical.effect: While under the effect of this drug you can use your STANDARD action as a QUICK action (can interrupt or react as well)

medical.name: Purgatol
medical.effect: Purgatol negates the effect of SICK caused by drugs; taking any other drugs while under the effect of Purgatol cancels this effect.

medical.name: Mono Saviol
medical.effect: Heavy-duty tranquilizer. The target makes an ENDURANCE save vs DC 5, resolved as a GRADED SAVE by shortfall (DC minus successes): no shortfall = no effect; shortfall 1 = DAZED; shortfall 2 = STUNNED; shortfall 3 or more = INCAPACITATED until their TOXICITY reaches 0. Each additional application raises the save DC by 1 and TOXICITY by 1, nudging the result one band harsher.

medical.name: Happi II
medical.effect: Puts user under a sense of constant bliss where nothing really matter.  Reduces maximum morale by 50% but ignore any MORALE loss that do not cause TRAUMA

medical.name: Re-Seth
medical.effect: Cancels the effect of all drugs currently affecting a target and reduces their TOXICITY by 5. If TOXICITY reaches 0 it also cancels a non permanent toxic shock affecting the target.

medical.name: Bogello
medical.effect: While under the effect of this drug. A player can attempt to roll a immediate RECOVERY to ignore an EVO affliction triggered by a critical faillure. If the recovery roll succeed the affliction does not trigger, otherwise it triggers as normal.

medical.name: Soul dust
medical.effect: Negates an ongoing EVO affliction. Any effect already caused by the affliction stays but the affliction immediately ends. Soul dust also resets the max one affliction per scene so you might trigger the affliction again.

medical.name: Lifebane Toxin
medical.effect: This poison grants a LARGE damage bonus Vs LIVING targets. Critical ailment with LIFEBANE apply the SICK ailment, if the ailment is already present, deal a TRAUMA instead.

medical.name: Reaper's Kiss
medical.effect: This poison applies two AILMENTS when injected or injested. The first AILMENT causes ONGOING 3 STUN HEALTH DAMAGE and cannot be removed before the 2nd ailment. The second AILMENT applies STUN.

medical.name: Soulmelt
medical.effect: This poison causes an AILMENT on contact that inflicts the target's curent CHI as ENERGY MORALE Damage until it is removed.

medical.name: NiteNite
medical.effect: This poison applies an AILMENT that changes everytime someone fails to recover from it. The initial AILMENT applies SLOW, then DAZED, STUNNED and finally DYING.

medical.name: Howler
medical.effect: This poison applies the VULNERABILITY 3 to ALL Damage AILMENT.

medical.name: Heamofrak
medical.effect: This poison has no effect when not combined with another source of damage. When combined with another source of damage Heamofrak grants a LARGE HEALTH damage bonus to the attack.

Altair Biomed.desc: Toxicity +3, double effect of instant meds or double duration for non-instant meds

RX Generic.desc: Medical check with those meds have a SMALL penalty. Generic meds to be used by seasoned professionals

Goodman Holistic.desc: Half toxicity, no other effect. Made from natural ingredients

Diva Solutions.desc: Drugs engineered for evading legal constraints. Caters to the rich and famous.

Mono-Med Customs.desc: Custom-made per individual. Only used by the very rich or in extreme medical cases.
